summary: Lifezone Metals Ltd filed a prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for a registered direct offering of 5,700,000 ordinary shares at $4.40 per share to institutional investors, with gross proceeds of ~$25.1M. The placement agent is Roth Capital Partners, earning a 6% cash fee. The offering is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation. The company is an emerging growth foreign private issuer. No special-situation mechanics apply. There is no risk-arb angle.
